name: run_ledger_mark_vs_last
description: Unrealized PnL follows the latest MARK, not the last trade price: a fill at 108 resets the mark to 108, and a later MARK at 102 overrides it again.
derivation: initial wallet 1000. AAA mult=1. FILL +2 @100 fee=0: entry=100, mark=100, wallet=1000, u=0, equity=1000. MARK 105: u=2*1*(105-100)=10; equity=1010. FILL -1 @108 fee=0: reducing; realized=(108-100)*1*1*(+1)=8; wallet=1008; entry stays 100; position=1; mark reset to the fill price 108; u=1*1*(108-100)=8; equity=1008+8=1016. MARK 102: u=1*1*(102-100)=2; wallet stays 1008; equity=1010. Final: wallet 1008, unrealized 2, equity 1010, realized 8, fees 0, funding 0, position +1. If uPnL used the last fill price (108) it would stay 8 and equity 1016; expected 2/1010 pins mark-vs-last.
